      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",

    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Introduces a complete in-tree unit test runner and assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} to replace Boost.Test.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replaces the external Boost.Test runner with an in-tree unit test framework, resolving longstanding developer friction and dependency maintenance issues. The new framework adds expression decomposition to print evaluated operand values upon failure and unblocks future test harness customizations such as test concurrency in CI."
